headline: A hacking group that researchers link to the Chinese government posed as an Anthropic employee and other AI figures to trick US policy experts into installing malware.
score_reason: Pool score kept: specific, sourced espionage campaign; attribution is the security firm's assessment.
importance_line: AI policy experts at US think tanks, universities and law firms were targeted, and their cloud accounts are at risk; the China link is Proofpoint's assessment and Anthropic's own role is only as the impersonated name.
summary: Futurism reports, citing a Proofpoint report and CNN, that a group called TA419, which Proofpoint says is aligned with the Chinese government, impersonated an Anthropic staffer and a former White House science official in emails to AI policy experts. After a few friendly exchanges about a made-up advisory committee, the group sent documents carrying malware meant to break into the targets' cloud accounts, and Proofpoint expects the campaign to continue.
notes: Proofpoint original not read; credit chain Proofpoint -> CNN -> Futurism.
